candidate.description: Chip stock selloff stole the spotlight this week. The chip stock selloff dominated the week, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index falling for an eighth straight session, its longest streak since 2008, and the Nasdaq sliding 4.5%. Yet TSMC posted a record profit up nearly 69% and ASML booked record sales, so the businesses kept growing while the share prices fell. Hot US inflation, Brent near $110 on Hormuz risks and a silent Fed added to the pressure, while Singapore's index held at 5,415.5
